item.description:
Reinstalling the fan helper now works on the first try.
## Fixed
- **"Operation not permitted" when reinstalling the helper.** Reinstall removed the old helper and installed the new one in the same instant, before macOS had finished the removal, so macOS refused it and pressing the button again was the only way through. ChillMac now waits for the removal to finish and retries for a few seconds if macOS is still busy. Fan control and monitoring were otherwise unaffected.

If fan control setup was failing with "Operation not permitted", ChillMac can now fix it for you with one password prompt.
## Fixed
- **Fan control setup blocked by an old helper.** ChillMac versions before 1.8.1 installed their fan helper differently, and updating never removed it. That leftover copy made macOS refuse to install the current one. ChillMac now spots it and offers a "Remove old helper" button that asks for your password once, removes it, and sets up fan control. Monitoring was never affected.
## Improvements
- **Diagnostics.** Exports now note whether an old helper is still installed.

Setting up fan control now tells you what went wrong instead of quietly doing nothing.
## Fixed
- **Install button that did nothing.** When macOS refused to install the fan helper, ChillMac only wrote the reason to its log, so pressing Install in setup or in the menu looked like a dead button. The reason now appears next to the button. Monitoring was never affected; only fan control was unavailable. - **Running outside Applications.** When macOS runs ChillMac from the disk image or a temporary copy, the helper can't be installed reliably. ChillMac now spots this and asks you to move it to Applications first.
## Improvements
- **Diagnostics.** Exports now include the fan helper's status and the last install error, so setup problems can be diagnosed from the file alone.
